source_record.inference: The explicit contribution is material at its stated guard even when final action is confirmed rather than changed. Corresponding mechanisms may overlap; duplicate names, reused tests and common pipelines do not create additional benefit or independence.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: Identical test behavior treated as unique artifact identity.
A green pipeline treated as exposure authority.
An approved model treated as actual deployed state.
The same test counted as independent evidence twice.
All evidence discarded after harmless change.
All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.
A trace link treated as proof of the linked claim.

positive_controls.argument: A representative executable example supplies recoverable knowledge of the observed interaction and exposes a discrepancy in the maintained explanation.
The exercised increment, environment record and result supply a concrete tested-state reference to configuration status accounting; behavioral discrepancy can reveal a mistaken attribution.
Representative integrated behavior supplies a functional correspondence input and an observed discrepancy when the implemented interaction contradicts the approved assumption.
An observed interaction result or failure provides concrete impact evidence for deciding the change route and the need for additional investigation.
A representative integrated execution tests shared units, protocol or timing behavior and supplies a concrete incompatibility witness when local assumptions disagree.
An executable increment can expose an infeasible criterion, missing observable or ambiguous expectation before the verification plan is relied upon.
The integrated exercise supplies evidence at its actual interaction level and may reveal a failure absent from component-only checks.
The identified executable example and result supply a concrete endpoint for a claim-to-evidence relation and expose an edge that names the wrong tested behavior.
The observed interaction contributes bounded evidence or a defeater to that runtime subclaim while other assurance premises remain explicit.
The observed failure supplies a reproducible problem witness; a relevant later execution supplies limited evidence for whether the repaired behavior changed.
A representative integrated observation can corroborate or contradict the modeled interaction and supplies a reality check for the claimed model scope.
An identified integration result supplies one behavior-bearing output for the pipeline and a failure that must not be replaced by a green status label.
